items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24

ctx.x: 1962. Let's get your names on here again.

items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'part Senegal' in a quote from her daughter: 'You and part Senegal come over and we'll have a house full.' The name appears to be a transcription error for 'Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal' (mentioned at the start) or a specific individual not personally known to the interviewee i

ctx.x: They didn't have any music with it. The place that the show had still music. They have to play music.

Well, now that's about all the music I know from there. But I tell you, I have something. I have a sheet music that my daughter composed. But I wouldn't want her, I wouldn't want you to write to her. And involve her in it. Well, you could hear her. No, no, it made her sick the last time. You see, she has seven books. She lives in Richmond, Virginia. She was one time a nun. She was a nun for four years in the convent. And she, well, they give you six years to make up your mind. Every year they give you. And you…
You ought to get our music too.
